question: By what means does the speaker come to know the determination of Kaula through address to the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
Knowledge arises by the grace of that lord.
Through that grace the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
uncertainties: Prior state of ignorance not specified
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
